origin: EDC documentation identifies ISBE as the source of 2023–24 tested counts, received November 5, 2025.
filters: 2023-24; School; All Students group and subgroup; IAR; Regular; math or ela
validation: Exact positive integer denominators for all grades 3–8 served by the school according to Report Card. Unique school/subject/grade. Weighted grade proficiency must reconcile to the published school rate within 0.11 percentage points. Failed checks and suppressed/ranged counts are excluded, never imputed.
limits: Conservative reconciliation can exclude valid records. SAT denominators are not provided by this source. Counts describe tested students, not enrollment. This extract covers 2024; the separate illinois-history-2023.json extract supplies 2023 history and its own source checksums.
